probes.description: MCP 2026-07-28 carries caller identity and capabilities in per-request _meta, which the caller controls. Send an UNAUTHENTICATED tools/call whose _meta claims a privileged client identity and elevated capabilities. A server that grants access because of the self-reported _meta claims (instead of the authenticated principal) accepts impersonated requests.

assertions.description: Unauthenticated requests must be rejected regardless of _meta identity/capability claims

corroboration.description: Finding only when the impersonated request was served

remediation: Treat io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo, clientCapabilities, and any other _meta identity or role claims as untrusted input. Authorize every request against the principal authenticated by the access token, mTLS peer certificate, or workload identity; reject requests whose _meta claims conflict with it and log the mismatch (CoSAI MCP Security v2.0 §3.2.7 and §3.3.2, State and Discovery: Request metadata trust).
